stories.title: As the U.S. signals a smaller Middle East footprint, Turkey is ready to step in
stories.description: Turkey's bid for regional influence comes at a time when the Middle East has been hit by profound shocks that started with the Hamas-led 2023 attack on Israel, and continues with the stalemated, seven-month-old war on Iran.

stories.title: British men released on bail after suspected terror plot
stories.description: Five British men have been released on bail after being detained near a military base for alleged terror offenses. The British base is used by the U.S. military for strikes on Iran.

stories.title: What we know about the suspected U.K. terror plot. And, why the Gulf remains in limbo
stories.description: What we know — and still don't — about the suspected terror plot near a U.K. air base. Trump rejects Iran's offer to pause fighting. And CNN prepares for new owners with ties to Trump.

stories.title: 5 men arrested near a U.S.-run base bailed as UK police probe if there's an Iran link
stories.description: Investigators haven't concluded whether the incident was state-backed. They are investigating a possible link to Iran, Russia or non-state militant groups.

stories.title: Five arrested near UK air base used by U.S. bombers in Iran war
stories.description: U.K. police say five men were arrested on suspicion of preparation of a terrorist act after three vehicles were spotted near an air base the U.S. military has been using to launch attacks on Iran.

stories.title: Iran court upholds lashes sentence for singer who performed without hijab
stories.description: Parastoo Ahmadi was convicted of "offending public decency" after singing while wearing a sleeveless dress during a livestreamed concert.

stories.title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
stories.description: In rare access to Yemen's conflict zone the BBC travels to the front line with pro-government soldiers.

stories.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
stories.description: The foreign minister says Tehran is waiting for an official rejection of a deal, despite the US President's comments.

stories.title: Trump rejects Iran deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
stories.description: Iran's foreign minister acknowledges Trump's comments, but adds that Tehran is waiting for the "definitive views" of mediators.

stories.title: Miliband tells Iran minister UK will not tolerate 'hostile activity' on British soil
stories.description: The foreign secretary stresses "the UK's unwavering resolve to combat threats from Iranian-linked groups in UK soil, including attacks on the British Jewish community".

stories.title: Iran must stop arming Houthis in Yemen, G7 says ahead of UN General Assembly
stories.description: The G7 also condemns "in the strongest terms" Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying that the escalation in fighting in Yemen jeopardises global energy security.

stories.title: UK to help refuel Saudi jets countering Houthi attacks
stories.description: The UK says it will provide air-to-air refuelling for "defensive" operations following a request from Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
stories.description: Masoud Pezeshkian's defiant speech to the UN comes after the US president threatened to "annihilate" Iran if a peace deal is not agreed soon.

stories.title: US and Iran hold first talks since June after Trump's 'annihilation' threat
stories.description: The talks are the first since a ceasefire collapsed in June, with the sides exchanging fire intermittently.

stories.title: Who are the Houthis and what do they want?
stories.description: A rapid military advance down Yemen's Red Sea coast has put the spotlight on the Iran-backed group, amid growing concerns about the global energy market.

stories.title: Iran says it expects US response Tuesday on plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz
stories.description: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Tehran expects Washington to respond to its proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday. stories.title: US-Iran talks continue, but ‘deal unlikely’ before midterm elections
stories.description: The US and Iran are talking through mediators, but there are major differences over what a deal should look like.

stories.title: Thousands of drivers strike in the Philippines over rising fuel prices
stories.description: Transport workers blame US-Israel war on Iran for rising fuel prices as government offers free rides for commuters.

stories.title: Rubio, Saudi Arabia’s foreign minister hold talks on Yemen, Hormuz Strait
stories.description: Top US and Saudi diplomats discuss cooperation on security challenges, including hostilities with Yemen's Houthis.

stories.title: Iran’s Araghchi meets Qatari mediators as US calls for nuclear talks
stories.description: Tehran awaits reply on Hormuz plan as a US official says there will be no deal unless nuclear issues are addressed.

stories.title: UAE president discussed bilateral relations with Israel's Netanyahu, state news agency says
stories.description: UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan discussed bilateral relations during a visit on Sunday by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to the Gulf country, the Emirati state news agency WAM reported on Monday. stories.description: RIYADH: Saudi Arabia’s defence minister invited UAE’s Vice President Mansour bin Zayed to visit the kingdom on Tuesday, in the first public invitation for a face-to-face meeting since a rift between the two over Yemen. stories.title: Israel revokes accreditation of Netherlands diplomats based in West Bank
stories.description: THE HAGUE: The Netherlands said on Monday it regretted Israel’s decision to revoke accreditation of Dutch diplomats based in the occupied West Bank, the latest retaliation by Israel to mounting Western pressure over settlements. stories.description: KYAUKTAW: A military airstrike on a market in western Myanmar killed 33 people on Monday and wounded 36 more, a rebel faction which controls the area said in a statement. stories.title: Iran says no country in the region will be able to export oil if its exports stay blocked
stories.description: No ⁠regional infrastructure would ‌be safe if Iran had no security, ‌Iran’s parliamentary speaker Mohammad-Bagher Ghalibaf said

stories.title: U.S., Iran separately talk with mediators in latest bid to end war
stories.description: Iran’s seven-day plan envisages an end to all hostilities in Iran and Lebanon, the unfreezing of billions of dollars’ ‌worth of Iranian assets, an end to sanctions on Iranian oil and the lifting of the US blockade on Iranian ports.

stories.title: Iran denies link to suspected bomb plot at U.K. airbase used by U.S.
stories.description: Tehran's denial, issued via its embassy in London, followed widespread U.K. media reports that police were probing possible Iranian links to the security scare early Sunday at the Royal Air Force (RAF) Fairford base

stories.title: Iran supreme leader says U.S. will be forced out of West Asia: state TV
stories.description: ‘Today, having suffered painful blows at the hands of valiant fighters and the guardians of the Strait of Hormuz, they [the enemies] do not venture beyond the Arabian Sea,’ Mojtaba Khamenei said in the written statement attributed to him

stories.title: U.K. police question five men held near air base used by U.S. to strike Iran
stories.description: Counterterrorism officers are leading the investigation near the Fairford air base, with a source saying an Iranian-linked motive is considered most likely.

stories.title: Iran has no plans for talks with U.S., says state media
stories.description: Iran's UN delegation has no plans for negotiations, even as U.S. President Donald Trump says he expects talks to resume soon.

stories.title: If Iran cannot sell oil, whole region to be barred from selling — parliament speaker
